what: What a render of a job of an attended Abyss session needs beside the session's own info.json: the tempo and the position its host reported, whether its transport ran, and where the instance's clocks stood. The recordings and their info.json are under Analyzer/Results/RevOceanCharacterization/work/abyss/session_<label>/ (not in Git).
jobSteps: the host begins a new run of blocks with every step of a job: the flush 10 s and the pre-roll 2 s in front of the recording, and the recording itself
oscillatorOrigin: internal sample (44.1 kHz, counted from the instance's first processed frame, where the lines take their input) at which the switch to Abyss restarted the 32 line oscillators. The grain phasors stood at their start value two samples in front of it, and the free-running clock of a stopped transport read zero at it.
holdout: session F, recordings h1*, h2*, h3*: locked; nothing is tuned on them
